title: you left before the leaves fell

Soft felt piano melody, a warm nylon-string guitar, mellow Rhodes chords, light tape hiss and vinyl crackle, steady soft rain with a little wind and rustling dry leaves in the background, a very soft dusty lo-fi beat at 66 BPM, gentle sub bass. Key of E minor turning warm. Fully instrumental: no vocals, no humming, no singing, no spoken words. No build-up, no drops, no sudden changes, no loud parts, no fade-in or fade-out: it starts and ends at the same soft level and stays perfectly even so it loops seamlessly. Feeling: peaceful, nostalgic, safe.
